about: Drives the Motion Atlas Studio Pro Standalone the way scripts/deliver.mjs does: storyboard-sheet surface, board chosen by --param board=<id>, largest storyboard canvas pinned to time t via data-fixed-t + the studio clock _T.

hostAdapter.page: Motion Atlas Studio Pro — Standalone.html (this repo's host page)
hostAdapter.seek: pins the largest storyboard canvas with the data-fixed-t attribute and the studio clock _T, then calls drawAllCanvases() — the same way scripts/deliver.mjs does
hostAdapter.boards: board ids come from V9_STORYBOARDS in studio-canvas-oauth.js; choose one with --param board=<id>
hostAdapter.note: example values for this repo's container; set them for your environment

setupExpr: a.setState({ surface: 'storyboard-sheet', playing: false, musicOn: false });
if (sel && params.board && sel.value !== 'v9:' + params.board) { sel.value = 'v9:' + params.board; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }
timelineExpr: return { total: sb.totalDurationSec, beats: (sb.beats || []).map((b) => ({ t0: b.tStartSec, t1: b.tEndSec, payoff: b.payoff === true })) };
seekExpr: const tt = beats.length ? t % beats[beats.length - 1].tEndSec : t;
const b = beats.find((x) => tt >= x.tStartSec && tt < x.tEndSec) || beats[0];
